summary: Dreamland Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding between its subsidiary Trendic International and LinkFung Innovation to develop an AI-powered image library platform. No financial terms, stake, or premium are disclosed; the MoU is preliminary and non-binding except for IP/confidentiality provisions. The board did not issue a recommendation or name advisors. This is a routine business development disclosure, not a special situation.
